title: Turn a diagonal pair into a 2x2 block
written_solution: Whenever two same-colored cells occupy opposite corners of a 2x2 box, fill the other two cells of that 2x2 with the same color. Preserve the rest of the grid.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (e8b-colors-reading grid) (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p))) (grid-positions grid))))) (for/fold ((out g)) ((color (in-list (e8b-colors-reading g)))) (let ((cells (find-color g color))) (for/fold ((acc out)) ((p (in-list cells))) (for/fold ((acc2 acc)) ((d (in-list (list (list 1 1) (list 1 -1))))) (let ((q (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))) (if (member? q cells) (let* ((rs (sort (list (first p) (first q)) <)) (cs (sort (list (second p) (second q)) <))) (for*/fold ((acc3 acc2)) ((r (in-list rs)) (c (in-list cs))) (set-cell acc3 r c color))) acc2))))))))
